prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right choice depends on your business size, budget, industry and goals (brand work vs. performance/growth vs. product/UX, B2B vs. B2C, etc.). To help you quickly:

If you want a short list to consider
- AKQA — known for digital product/experience design and innovation (enterprise/brand work).
- R/GA — strong in digital transformation, integrated campaigns and technology-driven creative.
- Goodby Silverstein & Partners — San Francisco creative agency, well-known for big-brand advertising.
- Huge — focuses on digital experience, UX and conversion-driven design for larger clients.
- Wpromote — performance marketing and growth (PPC, paid social, SEO) with national reach and SF presence.

How to pick the “best” for your needs
1. Define goals and KPIs (awareness, leads, CAC, LTV, revenue).  
2. Filter by specialty (performance vs. creative vs. product/UX vs. SEO).  
3. Check case studies, client list and measurable results.  
4. Read reviews on Clutch, G2 and Ad Age Agency Rankings; ask for references.  
5. Request a short paid pilot or a scoped test campaign before long commitments.  
6. Ask about reporting cadence, tools they use, team makeup and contract flexibility.

If you tell me:
- your industry, company size, monthly marketing budget, and primary goals (e.g., more leads, app installs, brand awareness),
I’ll recommend 3 agencies in San Francisco tailored to your needs and draft an outreach message you can send.
